title: Black & Cream Glam Living Room
headline: Black & Cream Glam Living Room: 8 Amazon Finds for a Moody, Expensive-Looking Space
seo_title: Black and Cream Glam Living Room: 8 Amazon Finds | Looks Like Luxe
description: Black and cream glam living room ideas from Amazon: a cream cloud sectional, boucle barrel chairs, black marble coffee table, arched mirror, abstract art, crystal chandelier and more. Eight well-reviewed picks.
intro: Black, cream and a flash of gold. It's the palette of every condo you've ever screenshotted at 1 a.m., and honestly? Correct.

I went looking for the pieces that make that moody, hotel-lobby living room: a big cream sectional, curvy boucle barrel chairs, black stone, a crystal chandelier that says 'yes, I did mean to be dramatic.' Every pick is rated 4.4 stars or higher with real review counts, and I checked the color on each listing.
On the product pages, choose the black or cream option I mention before you buy, since many of these come in several colors.
I haven't tested these. I'm telling you what's well reviewed and very much your aesthetic. Let's get glam.
disclosure: As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases, which means if you tap a link and buy, I may earn a small commission at no extra cost to you. Prices, colors and availability live on Amazon and change often.

products.name: 108" Cloud Sectional Sofa with Chaise, Beige
copy: A deep cloud-style sectional with a chaise in a creamy beige. It is the cozy, oversized base that all that black sits against.
It rates 4.4 stars from more than 1,200 reviewers. It ships in two packages, so check the size and layout on the page.
Verdict: start here and build the room around it.

products.name: Boucle Barrel Accent Chairs, Ivory (Set of 2)
copy: A pair of ivory boucle barrel chairs on black legs. The rounded shape softens a room full of sharp black edges.
They have a 4.4-star rating from about 475 reviewers, and the set includes two chairs.
Verdict: face them toward the sofa and you have a conversation corner.

products.name: Round Coffee Table with Black Faux Marble Top
copy: A round table with a black faux marble top. Black stone is the fastest way to make a room look expensive.
It has a 4.6-star rating from more than 340 reviewers.
Verdict: pick the Black Marble option and style it with a book and one candle.

products.name: Arched Full Length Floor Mirror, Black Frame
products.best_for: Light, height and drama in one leaning piece
copy: A tall arched mirror in a thin black frame. It bounces light around and makes a small living room feel bigger.
It rates 4.5 stars from more than 900 reviewers.
Verdict: lean it against the wall and call it a design choice.

products.name: Large Framed Black & White Abstract Wall Art, Set of 2
products.best_for: The art that does the decorating
copy: A framed set of two abstract pieces in black and ivory, the exact brushstroke look you keep saving.
It has a 4.6-star rating from more than 430 reviewers. Choose the Black Strokes option.
Verdict: hang them over the sofa and you are done.

products.name: Faux Black Pampas Grass Stems, 45 inch (8-pack)
copy: Black pampas stems that give you that tall, airy look with zero watering and zero shedding on your carpet.
They rate 4.6 stars from more than 1,400 reviewers.
Verdict: the easiest drama you can buy.

products.name: Modern Crystal Chandelier, 20 inch, 4 Tier
copy: A four-tier crystal chandelier. A fixture like this changes how a whole room feels the second you flip the switch.
It rates 4.6 stars from more than 500 reviewers. Check the size and ceiling height on the page, and have it installed safely.
Verdict: the one splurge that reads as designer.

products.name: Faux Cowhide Rug, 4.6 x 5.2 ft
products.best_for: The pattern that ties it together
copy: A faux cowhide rug that layers over a larger rug or sits under the coffee table for that collected look.
It has a 4.6-star rating from more than 220 reviewers. Pick the black and white option.
Verdict: pattern at your feet, a little bit of attitude.

interludes.3: Rule one of the glam room: black needs cream to breathe.
interludes.6: Rule two: go taller than you think. Stems, mirrors, vases.

outro: And that's the edit: eight Amazon finds for a black and cream glam living room.
If you take one thing from this guide, start with the mirror and the stems. It takes a room from builder-basic to boutique hotel in an afternoon.
